components.why_8_4_body:
Real data ke bina, sleep/social/circadian optimistic defaults lete hain. Typing aur journal neutral 5.0 pe rahte hain. Result: weighted avg ≈ 7.8 → 8.4 ho jaata hai.

Fix: Daily check-in karo → accurate score milega.

signals.keystroke_desc: Chat/journal mein typing speed, backspace rate aur ruk-ruk ke likhna measure karta hai.
signals.appUsage_desc: Check-in se neend quality track karta hai. Kharab neend = lower mood score.
signals.circadian_desc: App use ka time vs tera baseline sleep time compare karta hai. 3 AM pe open karna = 3 point deduction.
signals.socialWithdrawal_desc: Check-in se social engagement measure karta hai. Kisi se baat nahi = withdrawal signal.
signals.journalSentiment_desc: Gemini AI journal aur chat se emotional sentiment analyze karta hai.
